documented_hints: All sprite-sheet variants in this family share the same semantic meaning at the same grid coordinates.
Semantic meaning is anchored to family/region/grid identity rather than a specific colorway sheet.
The 1bit_colored_bg variant is the canonical first-pass review evidence sheet for cluster and meaning inference; final semantics still live at family level.

Minimal 8 uses an authoritative 8x8 tile grid, and the artist states the artwork is intentionally drawn as 7x7 inside those 8x8 cells. Grid-aligned tile ownership and runtime placement must therefore stay on the full 8x8 grid rather than following visible-pixel heuristics.

The default Minimal 8 art anchor is bottom-left: most tiles leave their intentional 1-pixel gutter on the top and right edges of the 8x8 cell. Synthetic tiles for this family should follow that same top-right gutter unless they are deliberately matching a canonical exception.

Cluster ids are intentionally dual-axis: source.* clusters track source-sheet column / cluster structure, while curated thematic clusters such as indoors.* and icons_and_items capture reuse semantics across that source structure.

Source-sheet ingest structure now lives separately in ingestion.json: regions describe top-level ingest areas, clusters describe grouped sub-areas within a region, optional ignore_regions can subtract exceptional non-tile sheet content when needed, and collections describe larger logical constructs built from multiple cells.

Synthetic or derived tiles are allowed at the family semantic layer. They do not need source-sheet ingest placement, but they should carry the same rich semantic metadata as canonical tiles plus clear provenance describing how they were generated.
